title: Had hvac team come in, my office no longer under under 60 degrees every day, but in terms of compressor cycling on and off every two minutes, nothing
summary: Had hvac team come in, my office no longer under under 60 degrees every day, but in terms of compressor cycling on and off every two minutes, nothing to do, Compressor is literally above my office. It fires so often so loud. I can no longer record. Makes online teaching hard
